description: This file defines the ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator class, which converts a ShippingSummary object into a ReadableShippingSummary object, populating data fields such as shipping costs, handling, and tax details. It relies on an external PricingService for formatting monetary amounts.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator
classes.description: A data populator class responsible for converting ShippingSummary objects into ReadableShippingSummary objects, handling data formatting and exception management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ReadableShippingSummary object with data from a ShippingSummary source, using merchant store and language context, and throws ConversionException on failure.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadableShippingSummary as the target object for population.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the PricingService instance used by this populator.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Sets the PricingService instance for use in formatting shipping cost amounts.
